snippet.title: Version 1.7 Teaser - "Bury Your Tears With the Past" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
Tonight, on the stage of New Eridu
The grand performance is about to reach its finale
The actors named "Misfortune" and "Sin" have silently taken their places...
May Lord Phaethon have a pleasant evening
Yours truly
Mockingbird

"Ladies and gentlemen, it's showtime!"

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5™/iOS/Android/PC | Version 1.6 "Among the Forgotten Ruins" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
